block.title: SKEET pods and VANE bladed fliers, encounter concept
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, subtle CRT scanline glow, square vertical poster crop. A heroic low-angle study of a VANE bladed flier: a compact gunmetal drone chassis wrapped by three spinning crescent-mirror wingblades, each blade a polished steel scythe with a lilac glint edge, hovering against a vast soft-focus backdrop of a blue planet's limb — green-teal terrain, white storm swirls, and a thin glowing cyan atmospheric arc cutting the corner of the frame. A single SKEET pod, an armored seed-shaped drone with a magenta eye-slit and rust-violet seams, rides the shadow at the edge of the composition. Sparse pixel stars dot the deep navy gradient sky, lifted never black. The mood is clean, cold and mechanical — an patrol arriving in orbit. Bold flat color shapes, limited palette, ultra-detailed large-format illustration with pixel-art texture accents.
